sources.snippet: Splinter-Memory is an external, multi-agent context-curation layer for long-horizon LLM conversations. It sits between a user and a local LLM backend, filtering, scoring, compressing, and reassembling conversation history into a bounded, high-relevance context window for every turn, so a generative model performs well over arbitrarily long conversations on consumer hardware.
